verdict.rationale: The changelog says Home is now a dashboard with a "daily brief" and "suggestions" cards summarizing what your Agents did while you were away. Onboarding also suggests concrete starter Tasks based on what you say about your work. That is the product's own in-app suggestion and insight capability, but it is documented only in brief changelog lines. It is unclear how far these insights are generated from the user's own data rather than from agent activity status. missing for 10: detailed docs on what data the daily brief and suggestions draw on, evidence of data-driven analytical insights beyond activity summaries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
